from cocotb.triggers import ClockCycles, FallingEdge, RisingEdge, Timer

CLK_NS = 10


async def start(dut):
    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.clk, CLK_NS, "ns").start())
    dut.wb_rst_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_adr_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_dat_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_we_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_stb_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
    dut.stretch_en.value = 0
    dut.ext_scl_low.value = 0
    dut.ext_sda_low.value = 0
    dut.rst_n.value = 0
    await ClockCycles(dut.clk, 2)
    await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.rst_n.value = 1
    await ClockCycles(dut.clk, 3)


async def wb_access(dut, address, data=None):
    """Perform one Wishbone access and return the read value, if applicable."""
    await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.wb_adr_i.value = address
    dut.wb_dat_i.value = 0 if data is None else data
    dut.wb_we_i.value = 0 if data is None else 1
    dut.wb_cyc_i.value = 1
    dut.wb_stb_i.value = 1

    await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.wb_ack_o.value) == 1
    result = int(dut.wb_dat_o.value)

    await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.wb_ack_o.value) == 0

    await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_stb_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_we_i.value = 0
    return result

    return await wb_access(dut, address)


async def wb_write(dut, address, data):
    await wb_access(dut, address, data)

async def wb_access(dut, addr, write=False, data=0):
    """Perform one Wishbone access and return read data from its acknowledge cycle."""
    await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.wb_adr_i.value = addr
    dut.wb_dat_i.value = data
    dut.wb_we_i.value = int(write)
    dut.wb_cyc_i.value = 1
    dut.wb_stb_i.value = 1

    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.wb_ack_o.value) == 1, "Wishbone acknowledge did not rise"
    read_data = int(dut.wb_dat_o.value)

    await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
    await Timer(1, unit="ns")
    assert int(dut.wb_ack_o.value) == 0, "Wishbone acknowledge was not one clock wide"

    await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
    dut.wb_cyc_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_stb_i.value = 0
    dut.wb_we_i.value = 0
    return read_data
